m.s: In a large bowl mix {beef_mince}, {pork_mince}, {panko}, {eggs}, grated {parm*0.5}, {garlic*0.5} (crushed), chopped {parsley} and 1 tsp salt. Mix with your hands until it just comes together.
Roll into golf ball sizes, about five per serve. Wet your hands to stop it sticking.
Heat a drizzle of oil in a large deep frying pan over medium-high heat. Brown the meatballs in batches for 5 minutes, turning, until golden all over. They finish cooking in the sauce. Set aside.

In the same pan, cook finely diced {onion} over medium heat for 5 minutes until soft. Add the rest of the garlic and {oregano} for 1 minute, then {passata} and {tintom}. Return the meatballs and simmer, half covered, for 20 minutes.
Cook {pasta} in a big pot of well-salted boiling water until al dente. Scoop out a mug of pasta water, then drain and toss with a few spoonfuls of the sauce and a splash of the water.
Serve the meatballs and sauce over the pasta with the rest of the parmesan grated over the top.

l: Meatballs and sauce reheat beautifully. Use a splash of water to loosen it. Keeps 3 days in the fridge, and the meatballs freeze well.
g: GF crumbs in a separate small batch of meatballs, cooked first, and GF pasta in its own pot.
